title: Примирение Макса и Саши  (Max and Sasha Make Up)

segments.t: In the kitchen, Max approaches Sasha to apologize for his foolish jealousy over Ilya, assuring her that the past is in the past. As soon as Max steps away, however, Kostya pulls Sasha aside and insists they have to confess what happened between them.
Конечно, глупо ревновать тебя к Илье.
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
'Kostya, please make a pot of tea.' In Russian, the idea of 'Kostya' flows naturally into 'teapot' without extra filler words. Kostya answers right away.
'Hey there, Max.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'regards' before landing on 'Max'.
'Listen, Sashulya, please forgive me.' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'listen' and 'Sasha' in a few short words.
'I have thought everything through.' Notice how Russian expresses 'but' and 'to realize' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.
Конечно, глупо ревновать тебя к Илье.
'Of course it is foolish to be jealous of you over Ilya.' In Russian, the idea of 'of course' flows naturally into 'Ilya' without extra filler words.
'The past stays in the past.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'last' before landing on 'was left'.
'Will you forgive me?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'to forgive' and finishing on 'me'. Kostya answers right away.
'I am still upset with you.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'you' in spoken Russian.
'But I am not holding a grudge.' Sasha anchors the line on 'but', while 'keep' completes the thought.
'This is for you.' Max addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'you'. Kostya answers right away.
'Sasha, let us tell Max everything.' The grammar packs 'Sasha' and 'Max' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'What are you two discussing?' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'what' and 'to discuss' in a few short words. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
Конечно, глупо ревновать тебя к Илье.

That wraps up this scene as max apologizes to Sasha for being jealous of Ilya and gives her a peace offering, while Kostya urgently whispers to Sasha that they must tell Max the truth. Until next time!
